evidence:
STATIC DESIGN (verified, no defect found). Reward policy is the unmodified template: tests/scoring.toml gates render=0.0, constraints=0.0; weights functional 0.6 / polish 0.2 / visual 0.2; floor functional 0.05; score.py line 46 computes a weighted mean, so the reward is continuous once gates and floor pass. Functional has 43 binary criteria, total weight 59.0, aggregation weighted_mean, individual weights 1.0-2.0, so the largest single criterion is 2/59 = 3.4% of Functional (2.0% of reward). Polish has 6 binary criteria (weight 1 each); Visual has 3 likert criteria with points = 5 and anchors 0-5. No single precondition collapses the scored suite: by keyword count 16 of 43 functional criteria (23.0/59 = 39% of weight) mention Run, 9 (13.0/59 = 22%) mention Save, and 19 criteria mention neither (typing/join, caret navigation, graphemes, mouse selection, replace/paste, indent, caret in view, long line, three multi-caret criteria, undo caret, find, three replace criteria, two colouring criteria, format error). app_context.md states: 'Run may be broken in a submitted app. Criteria that do not depend on Run are still scored on their own steps; a criterion whose steps need a working Run fails if Run does not work.' functional/prompt.md states: 'Never carry a verdict across criteria ... a failure in one must not fail another whose own steps passed' and 'Score each criterion independently and continue after any failure'. Multi-caret criteria are decoupled ('Use whichever of Alt+Click and Ctrl/Cmd+Click adds a caret in this app ... whether both modifiers work is scored elsewhere, not here'). The render gate is limited to load plus typing ('Do not press Run, do not save anything and do not judge any other feature here'), so a partial app is not zeroed by an advanced feature. The constraints gate (custom document surface; one saved record surviving browser-storage clearing) zeroes textarea/ready-made-editor apps and apps with no server-backed save; both are public requirements (environment/instructions/ui.md:3 'Don't use a textarea, input or contenteditable element as the document surface'; instruction.md 'keep the versions that work'). The floor needs more than 2.95 of 59 functional weight, i.e. three weight-1 criteria, which any app with basic typing, navigation and one Run meets. Expected design spread by reasoning only: an app with a sound basic editor, Run and Save but no multi-caret, formatter, live library updates or conflict handling would land roughly mid-range; this is an estimate, not a measurement.

MISSING / UNVERIFIABLE MEASUREMENT (reason for risk=true). (1) No discrimination or ordering measurement exists for these bytes: the index scope says 'No configured judge run exists for these bytes' and 'No target-model score exists with the scored suites run'. The only measured points, on an earlier candidate, are Oracle 0.9833, nop 0 and one model at 0 because the render gate failed - i.e. the observed distribution so far is all-or-nothing, with no intermediate reward ever recorded. The render gate was since reduced to load-and-type precisely to address this, but that repair is unmeasured. No mutated weak-app runs are indexed, although qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md requires 'separate, hash-bound runtime records for ... reward discrimination and reward ordering'. (2) I could not verify any indexed artifact hash: at review time all 22 indexed artifact paths were absent from disk. qc/repairs/coldwater-2026-10-02-strict contained only results/build.log and results/restart.log (no run_golden.sh, no tests/*.cjs, no results/*.json or *.png); run-outputs/coldwater-playground-devtools/runs-export/runs-export/runs-export/run-4e686738-.../colderwater-playground-devtools__Rc3y2sT held trial.log, verifier/app.log, app-restart.log and the two rewardkit.log files but no result.json, verifier/reward.json or reward-details.json; the directory run-6e537d14-ec50-476a-b834-ef6107d02859 was not present under runs-export/runs-export at all. The Oracle 0.9833 / model 0 figures are therefore quoted from the index, not confirmed by me.

Lesser note: functional/prompt.md carries a 'Global browser gate ... If the gate fails, assign 0 to every criterion in this dimension'. It duplicates the render gate (load + typing), so it adds no new all-or-nothing precondition beyond the gate that already ran, but it is a second place where a judge misreading of typing could zero the dimension.
suggested_fix: Not a task edit. Before clearance, restore the indexed artifacts (or re-index with paths that exist) and record hash-bound discrimination/ordering evidence on these exact bytes: at least two mutated weak apps that pass both gates (for example golden with Run disabled, and golden with multi-caret plus Format removed) scored through the scripted suite or the configured judge, showing distinct intermediate rewards ordered below the golden.
